==English==

===Etymology===
Borrowed from {{bor|en|la|Hēliopolis}}, from {{der|en|grc|[[Ἡλίου πόλις]]||[[sun|Sun]] [[city|City]]}}, from the important solar cults of [[Ra]] and [[Baal]]. Doublet of [[Surajpur#English|Surajpur]].

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌhiːliˈɒpəlɪs/|ref="Heliopolis" in ''Oxford Dictionaries''.}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Sumxr-Heliopolis.wav|a=US}}

===Proper noun===
{{en-proper noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q191687}}{{lb|en|historical}} {{place|en|The <<ancient capital>> of the 13th [[nome]] of <<r/Lower Egypt>>, located in the [[northern]] [[suburb]]s of [[modern]] <<city/Cairo>>, <<c/Egypt>>}}.
#: {{syn|en|Iunu|qq1=its name in Ancient Egypt|Iwnw|On|qq3=Coptic|Awen|Heliopolis in Augustamnica}}
